# The Jarred Effect

> The Jarred Effect teaches the other half of manifestation. Most law-of-attraction teaching covers one side: desire, belief and good feelings. The Jarred Effect adds the other side: discipline, friction and shadow work, so results hold up on a bad day. Founded by Jarred. Tagline: "Manifestation has two sides."

Core ideas:
- The polarity principle: every result has two poles that work together, such as desire and discipline, or faith and friction.
- Chasing only the "high vibe" pole leads to burnout dressed up as spirituality.
- Balance is a skill built in practice, not a mood. If a practice can't survive a bad Tuesday, it doesn't make the cut.
- No belief system required: the ideas can be read as energetic, psychological or simply how people change.
